    Google, HHMI Janelia and collaborators published the male fruit fly nervous-system reconstruction. They did not run this citizenship experiment. FLY is an independent computational project that uses the released anatomy. The fly’s movements, paper storm and brain overload are authored satire.

    32/32Lab trials after training, four directly stimulated neural patterns
    30/32Replication with different ensembles
    0/16Visual learning gate, held-out trials
    0/33Untrained citizenship practice exam, 33 abstentions

    The 32/32 and 30/32 scores concern familiar neural patterns, not German questions. The failed visual gate kept citizenship training from starting. There is no measured time-to-pass.
